_about: Default game rules, used by tile sets that don't name their own.
distance = [min, max] rooms walked from 'from' (default: the start); null = no max.
Rule fields on a marker type (distance, prefer, pick...) are defaults for its rules; a rule's own value wins.
prefer: off_route, dead_end, junction, big or room tags, tried in order; tagged rooms without a marker come first.
Spawns prefer big rooms (more room to fight), then junctions, like dungeon-generator's open rooms.
Markers sit on every other tile (a checkerboard); every slot the rules leave empty gets a '?' event.
